modes.A: T8 rules (3 every year, course 1), T8 catalogue
modes.N: T9 allowances and costs without the free-evening roll, T8 catalogue (resource only)
modes.B: Full T9 rules incl. free-evening roll, T8 catalogue
modes.C: T9 rules and T9 free-time moments (shipped)

methodology.loop: Resolve stories with the T8 policy choice (economy-t8a hash, first available fallback); focus by policy; three real beats; then one shop window (financialDecisions) before tick. Same as the T8 audit.
methodology.moments: planned: accept a moment only if it does not change the purchases the policy would make this year (financialDecisions before/after the real takeMoment on a copy); greedy: accept every affordable moment before the shop.
methodology.accounting: Personal time spent per year = year limit − remainder before tick (moments, catalogue purchases and story purchases). Adult years are 18+.
methodology.windows: At the shop window each eligible offer is classified by canBuy: available, blocked only by personal time, blocked by money; other refusals (age, cooldown, conditions, targets) are excluded.
limits: Bots accept every affordable moment their plan allows; humans are pickier.
Moment offers are rolled by the engine (≤ 1 per beat, 3 beats a year); the audit never forces offers.
Mean lifetime values include infant deaths; checkpoint rows report survivors.
